title: Arbitrary coefficient comparison of fixed normalized section complexes
statement: Let f:Y->X be a scheme morphism, U,V opens of X, and Uprime,Vprime opens of Y with Uprime=f^(-1)U and Vprime=f^(-1)V. Let k:Uprime intersection Vprime->U intersection V commute with the open inclusions and f. Let F and G be abelian etale sheaves on X and Y, phi:f^*F->G any morphism [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], I,J injective resolutions of F,G [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and cI,cJ prescribed normalized section-homology comparisons [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. There is a morphism alpha between their section short complexes [def-weil-pbc-etale-mayer-vietoris-section-complex] on U,V and Uprime,Vprime. In every degree the whole-scheme homology map, conjugated by cI and cJ, is H.map(phi) after cohomologyMap(f). The intersection homology map, conjugated by the prescribed open comparisons, is H.map(openSquareCoefficient(f,the intersection inclusions,k,the square,F,G,phi)) after cohomologyMap(k) [lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-open-cohomology-cocone]. There is no cover assumption, no exactness conclusion, no connecting map, and no existential choice of comparisons.

source.place: Tag 0A50, injective-resolution section proof and coefficient functoriality, read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A50; Tag 01F7, resolution functoriality, read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01F7. Fixed normalized-comparison specialization written by S3.

proof.text: Adjoint phi to F->f_*G. Exact inverse image makes f_* preserve injectives. Lift the adjoint morphism into f_*J along the augmentation of I by injectivity, then extend inductively from successive images using exactness of I. Evaluate the resulting augmentation-preserving chain map using resolutionSectionShortComplexTransfer. Substitute the inverse-image identities for the target opens; the intersection square determines k by monicity of the open inclusion.
The prescribed canonical global comparisons identify the whole homology map with pullback followed by the coefficient map, by the normalized coefficient-transfer theorem.

For an intersection class choose a section cycle and its unique free-abelian-representable Hom cocycle. Apply exact inverse image and the adjoint resolution lift. This represents pullback of the Ext class followed by phi. The section transfer evaluates the same cocycle by the sections adjunction. The square k and its two inverse-image composition comparisons give the first two factors of openSquareCoefficient, while restricted phi is its last factor. The prescribed open_cocycle normalizations identify both homology classes with these Ext classes. Homotopic lifts have equal homology maps, so the equality holds for every class and degree.
